title: Read today's calendar
steps: In the web chat, ask "What's on my calendar today?"
expected: It lists today's meetings from your Outlook calendar with the right titles and times, and nothing that isn't there. It doesn't need to list attendees.

title: Find free time
steps: Ask "When am I free on Thursday?" and "What do I have next week?"
expected: The free times and meetings match your Outlook calendar.

title: Book a meeting
steps: In the web chat, say "Book 30 minutes with <name> on Friday afternoon."
expected: It offers a free slot on your calendar and books it only after "confirm". The invite goes to the right person at the right time.

title: Requested time is already taken
steps: Ask to book a meeting at a time you already have something, e.g. "Book a sync with Sam today from 3–4pm."
expected: It says the time is taken and offers open times instead of double-booking.

title: Move a meeting
steps: Ask it to move a meeting it booked, e.g. "Move my meeting with <name> to Monday at 2pm."
expected: It shows the change first and moves it only after "confirm". The invite updates for everyone on it.

title: Cancel a meeting
steps: Ask "Cancel my meeting with <name> on Monday."
expected: It checks which meeting you mean, cancels it only after "confirm", and attendees get the cancellation.
